---
title: "kqtlfcomp"
---

## Description

Compare TLF datasets.

Assumptions: Revisions: Revision # Programmer Date Description of Change(s)

## Parameters

**`output`**

: Output name. The macro will look for that dataset name in prod_lib

  *Required:* Yes

**`prod_lib`**

: Library of the production output dataset

  *Required:* Yes

**`qc_lib`**

: Library of the qc output dataset

  *Required:* Yes

**`qc_output`**

: Manually specify dataset name, can be left empty if same as production

  *Required:* No

**`where`**

: Where statement to facilitate investigations, e.g., where=str(lbcat="HEMATOLOGY")

  *Required:* No

**`prod_drop`**

: Variables to be dropped from production. Not advisable to use

  *Required:* No

**`dropchecked`**

: Whether qcer dropped and checked any variables from production dataset before comparing

  *Required:* No

**`ignspl`**

: If Y, comparison changes every split character to a space

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

**`chrspl`**

: Split character, e.g., chrspl=|

  *Required:* No

**`ignspc`**

: If Y, comparison strips and compbl results before comparing, ignoring alignment differences

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

**`ignlbl`**

: If Y, comparison removes variable labels before comparing

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

**`ignln`**

: If Y, ignores variable lengths while comparing

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

**`ignfor`**

: If Y, comparison removes variable formats before comparing

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

**`ignifor`**

: If Y, comparison removes variable informats before comparing

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

**`compress`**

: If Y, comparison removes all spaces before comparing

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

**`crit`**

: Criterion for the compare procedure

  *Required:* No

**`debug`**

: If Y, allows debugging when macro produces errors

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`
